valuation.method: Forward adjusted operating EPS x P/E. Each case uses FY2027 adjusted operating EPS (the year priced at the 2027-11-18 target date). Anchors: Q3 2026 adjusted operating EPS $5.06; 2026 guidance narrowed to $12.50-12.80 (midpoint $12.65); company will refresh 2027-2028 guidance with year-end results. FY2027 EPS values are our assumptions off the 2026 midpoint; multiples are judgement against merchant-nuclear/IPP ranges, not broker targets. US common share in USD, so no ADR or FX conversion applies.

bear.driver: Lower power prices and contract repricing flatten earnings; multiple compresses as AI-load enthusiasm fades

base.driver: Nuclear uprates, Calpine integration and data-center contracts lift earnings

bull.driver: Additional hyperscaler contracts at premium prices and 2027-28 guidance above expectations

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027 EPS of $14.50 the close of $280.2 implies 19.3x (22.2x on 2026 midpoint EPS of $12.65). Named analyst targets were not retrieved.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $14.50 (5.2% of the close, 5.2 percentage points of price return).
valuation.watch_metric: 2027 adjusted operating EPS guidance versus the $14.50 base and the 2026 result against the $12.50-12.80 range.
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 and full-year 2026 results with refreshed 2027-2028 guidance, expected around February 2027 (date not announced).

analyst_notes: No named-analyst calls with verifiable dates were retrieved, so coverage is marked unavailable. Published consensus for 2026 EPS (about $12.20) predates the guidance raise and is stale; shares are down over 30% year to date.

sources.label: Raises 2026 earnings outlook after Q3 beat
